Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", "{\"pdf_options\":{\"extract_metadata\":true,\"hierarchy\":{\"enabled\":true,\"include_bbox\":true,\"k_clusters\":6}}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].pages() as Any)
```
